pose_scope: normalized standing poses of the first standing-interactable pickupable Cup in sorted evaluator identity order
overbound_rule: if observed count exceeds 256, freeze 256 unique integer ranks spanning the complete deterministic order, including both endpoints, before any stability outcome
stable_rule: 3/3 fresh-reset trials pass all seven preconditions
query_failure_rule: hard stop after an explicit reset-restoration audit
public_output_policy: observed/selected/omitted counts, classifications and digests only; no selected ranks, coordinates or evaluator identity instances
private_output_policy: selected ranks, pose digests, poses, evaluator identities and trial rows only under ignored outputs
